messages:
Ava: Kicking off a rollup thread for the upcoming OSS tutorial series + refapp launch. Need: launch post, GitHub release notes, bench highlights, webinar (optional), and partner co-marketing asks. Who's on what?
Diego: I can do the GitHub release notes and the quickstart README. Plan: short TL;DR + code snippets + upgrade notes.
Priya: I'll lead the launch post and social cadence. Suggest 3-phase: teaser (7d), launch (day 0), deep-dive blog (day +3). Also want 2 social angles: "build with code" and "performance wins".
Omar: Bench owner here. I'll produce a one-slide summary + 3 short blurbs: cost, latency, throughput. Need to standardize the test harness and seed prompts.
Ava: Good. Diego, include an example Dockerfile snippet and a one-command deploy in the README. Keep the sample app language-agnostic (node + python snippets).
Diego: Will do. Also adding a CODE_OF_CONDUCT and CONTRIBUTING.md to lower friction for community PRs.
Priya: For the launch post outline: 1) problem we solve, 2) what the refapp includes, 3) bench highlights, 4) tutorial path (0->deploy), 5) how to get help (discord/community), 6) CTA to join webinar. Any objections?
Omar: Quick note on benches: run baseline on default runtime (no cache), then optimized with caching + quantization profile Q4. We'll publish p50/p95/p99 and cost per 1k tokens.
Ava: I want an honest note about limitations: sample dataset size, and that results vary by prompt shape. Callouts help trust.
Priya: Agreed. Also include a small FAQ section addressing "Is this production-ready?" and "How to adapt to private deployments?"
Omar: Can someone provide a representative prompt set (50 prompts) and token distributions? Diego, can the refapp include the prompt fixtures in /tests/bench_prompts.json?
Diego: Yup, will add a test-fixtures folder.
Priya: For webinar idea: 45-min live demo (30-min build + 15 Q&A). Keep it focused on "from repo -> live refapp" and show the bench slide. We can gate seats and surface enterprise leads.
Ava: Measurement plan: track repo clones, stars, site visits to /tutorial, webinar signups, and post-launch PRs. Add UTM params to all links.
content-bot: Reminder created: "Publish teaser tweet" scheduled for 7 days before launch.
Priya: CTA variants: A) "Try the refapp" (developer-focused) B) "See latency & cost" (platform/team lead-focused). We'll A/B the header and lead paragraph in the post.
Omar: For bench visuals: two PNGs: 1) cost comparison bar chart, 2) latency CDF. Will push to /assets/bench_cost.png and /assets/bench_latency.png.
Diego: I'll open a PR to add the example deploy script and linking to the assets.
Ava: Partner co-marketing: reach out to vector-db partner to cross-post. Priya, can you draft a short partner email template?
Priya: On it. Also drafting a one-paragraph blurb partners can paste into newsletters.
Omar: Timeline check: benches & figures by EOD in 48 hours, README & samples PR in 72 hours, launch post ready for review 5 days before publish.
Priya: I'll set up the HubSpot form with fields: name, email, company, role, company_size, interest (pilot/try/demo). Routing rules: pilot -> AE, demo -> SDR, try -> automated onboarding.
Ava: Make sure the form sets hubspot property "source=oss-refapp-launch" and adds list "oss-refapp-launchers".
Diego: I'll include a short CODE_EXAMPLE in the post showing how to call the API: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}'`
Priya: Can we also prepare a short pre-recorded clip (2-3 min) to include in the registration email? That boosts attendance.
Ava: Yes. Diego can record a quick tour of the README & deploy steps.
content-bot: Task added: "Record pre-demo clip" assigned to Diego, due in 48 hours.
Priya: Metrics to monitor after launch: registrant -> attendee conversion, repo forks, issue volume, and inbound demo requests. We'll report 1 week post-launch.
Omar: One more: annotate the bench with reproducibility steps and seed RNGs so others can validate.
Ava: Great point. Include exact runtime flags and model checksums in the bench appendix.
Priya: Owners recap: Priya = launch post & social, Diego = repo & sample app, Omar = benches & figures, Ava = overall program & partners. I'll post the editorial calendar later today.
Ava: Thanks everyone. Small ask: keep messages to quick updates here so we can capture decisions. Closing thread for now; will reopen if blockers come up. :sparkles:
